paper_title: Low-Energy Supernovae Severely Constrain Radiative Particle Decays
suggested_experiment_name: LESNe radiative decay bound (0.1 B, R_*=5e13 cm)
notes: Supernova calorimetric bound on ALP-photon coupling from low-energy supernovae. The paper's main result (Fig. 2) excludes a closed region of the ma-Gagamma plane for 1-500 MeV ALPs, bounded below (~m^-1 scaling) and above (trapping/decay outside progenitor). Data points are approximate readings of the excluded region boundaries from Fig. 2 (red-shaded region for R*=5e13 cm, Emantle<0.1 B); lower branch is the lower boundary, upper values sketch the upper boundary. No numerical table provided, so values are estimated from the log-log plot and are approximate.
